summary: Umatilla NF emergency cabin on Smoothing Iron Ridge, built 1933 or 1935; moved in 1950 and 2003 and now standing on private land in Whitman County.

facts.status_note: The ridge cabin moved in 1950 and again in 2003; it stands on private land in Whitman County. The register lists the ridge site as gone.

access.note: The relocated cabin is on private property in Whitman County; Ralph and Peggy Owen visited it in 2021 with special permission. The original ridge is National Forest ground.

visit.trail_note: Willhite Web: from Pomeroy take 15th Street south, then FR-44 to Round Prairie; 500 to 1000 feet of easy walking to the original ridge site

events.note: Willhite Web: during a 1933 CCC camp in the Asotin District, one project was the emergency lookout house; other sources give 1935
Dated 1935 by the register, firelookout.com and Rex's page; register panoramas dated August 7, 1935
Used for emergencies in the 1940s; no exact start year given
Moved off the ridge to a farm 4.5 miles (firelookout.com) or 5 miles (Willhite Web) northeast
Farm sold to WDFW and Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation; cabin moved to family property on another ranch in Whitman County

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict: 1933 CCC camp (Willhite Web) vs 1935 (register, firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts page). Current condition of the relocated cabin rests on Willhite Web's 2021 account and FFLA's Standing entry; neither is independent. Status correction proposed from gone to relocated, the vocabulary key for a structure moved to a new site. Record point 46.1919, -117.4094 is about 1.1 km from the FFLA ridge point 46.18232, -117.41235; not proposed as a correction. Record kind 'unknown'; FFLA types both entries as Ground, so the editor may set 'ground'. The sibling record us-wa-smoothing-iron-ridge (researched 2026-10-09) covers the same site and uses 'moved', which is not in the status vocabulary; a human should decide whether the two IDs are duplicates. Willhite's 1950 move line says 'possibly by Steve Black', which this story leaves out.
